description: Use this when the person wants more detail about one advisor from a search. Returns the public profile of a fee-only advisor listed on Wellspent, by the slug returned from search_fee_only_advisors (the last path segment of their profile_url). Advisor-maintained (member) profiles include the advisor's own description of their specialties, ideal client, fees, and background; directory-built records include listing facts and any public enrichment (bio, services, fee models, AUM). Contact details are not included. Send the person to profile_url to get in touch. Cite "Source: Wellspent, find.wellspent.co".
name: get_advisor_profile

outputSchema.description: found=false: {slug, message}. Advisor-maintained profiles carry the member's own fields; public_directory_listings records carry listing facts and optional public_enrichment.

dealer_affiliation.description: Canada: the listing's investment or mutual fund dealer, from the firm's own disclosures (not fee-only).

firm_website.description: Facts from the firm's own website (specialties, fees and pricing, virtual, languages, accepting new clients), each backed by a quote found on the page (evidence), with the date checked.

pricing.description: Fees the advisor stated; null fields were not stated. aumPercent is the annual % on the first $1M.

sec_record.description: Public SEC (IAPD / Form ADV) facts linked to a directory listing by name and current firm.

title: Get a fee-only advisor's public profile
